s.n: Jersey gravy fries with melted cheese
s.note: the long night drive across New Jersey
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour for 1 minute, then whisk in 500ml beef stock and 1 tsp Worcestershire and simmer 5 minutes until thick. Pile the chips onto a tray, scatter with 150g grated mozzarella and grill 2 minutes until melted. Pour over the hot gravy and top with pepper and sliced spring onion.

s.note: the stop at Freakshow's house, the strangest of the night
s.how: Pat 16 dill pickle spears very dry. Whisk 1 egg and 125ml buttermilk. Mix 75g plain flour, 75g fine polenta, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Dip the spears in buttermilk, then the flour mix. Fry at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and drain. Mix 100g sour cream, 60ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill, chives and a crushed garlic clove for dipping.

m.note: the little square burgers they crave all night
m.how: Press 600g beef mince thin across a lined tray and cut into 16 squares. Spread 2 finely diced onions in a hot pan with a splash of water, lay the patties on top, cover and steam 3 minutes. Add cheese and serve in 16 small soft buns with pickles.

w.note: the end of the quest, finally at the counter
w.how: Make salted caramel: melt 100g sugar until amber, whisk in 80ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp salt, and cool. Drizzle some inside 4 tall glasses. Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp of the caramel until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a drizzle more caramel.

d.note: the drive through the night in Harold's car
d.how: Simmer 200g frozen pitted cherries with 80g sugar and 80ml water for 10 minutes, mashing them, then strain and stir in 1 tsp vanilla. Cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Add 40ml cherry syrup and a squeeze of lime to each, then top with 250ml cold cola. Stir gently and add a cherry and a lime wedge.
